text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Narita Brian weeding 
the field alongside the groundskeeper.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Swarming all over... How annoying! Just 
how many of you do I have to take down!?

text_block_list.name: Janitor
text_block_list.text:
It's a punishment. She walked into the 
field and stepped on the seedlings, so I'm 
having her pull weeds.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I told you I didn't do it on purpose, 
didn't I!? Dammit...! I'm just utterly out 
of luck!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Argh! In that case, I'll just go wild! 
Prepare yourselves, you measly weeds!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She vigorously rushed off to pull weeds. 
Staying hunched over weeding for so long 
would be exhausting, even for her...
